name: specclaw
description: Lean, output-first spec-driven builds: mock first, then propose, plan, build, verify, pr.

gate.title: Propose gate
gate.description: warn (default), block or off. warn: allow Edit, Write and NotebookEdit on project files outside .specclaw/ and .git/ when no change is approved, and show a toast. block: deny those edits (a change's state.json and anything that would break the mod's reads included) until a change is approved. off: no check.
